name: Code Candy Interaction Gallery
source: User-provided public TikTok links from @code_candy; reconstructed from visible code frames and thumbnails.

options.useCase: Dark premium login/signup card with a gradient slanted overlay. Click only; no autoplay.
Compact nav or tool rail where labels reveal on hover/focus.
Mobile or compact nav with a circular active indicator. Starts inactive; click only, no autoplay.
Light auth surface needing a clean click-triggered overlay slide between sign-in and create-account states.

useWhen: A project needs to compare the four Code Candy stateful interaction entries in one place before choosing a specific reusable folder.
avoid: treating the gallery as a production page
autoplaying auth or nav state changes
rendering code snippets in visual previews
reducedMotion: Disable animated state transitions and show the target state instantly.
implementationNotes: Use the four standalone folders for implementation handoff; keep this folder as a preview gallery.
Stateful controls must wait for explicit user input: click, hover, or focus depending on pattern.
Do not include video-title/headline overlays from the source videos in production components.
Do not render code snippets inside visual previews; keep previews design-only so agents do not copy code text into UI.
Keep reduced-motion fallbacks: disable nonessential transitions and show the final static state.
